title: G1 newsletter covers everything about the 2026 elections
subtitle: Learn how the free bulletin that arrives every Tuesday to your email works
excerpt: G1 launches a free weekly newsletter with comprehensive coverage of the 2026 elections, providing summaries of candidates, proposals, and polls before the polls open.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
With the first round of the 2026 elections scheduled for October 4, interest in information about the presidential, state, and legislative races has increased significantly. In response to demand, G1 began sending, every Tuesday, an electronic bulletin that compiles the main news from the electoral process.

What the G1 newsletter offers

The bulletin contains a summary of the most relevant news about the contests for the Presidency, state governments, and seats in the National Congress, state assemblies, and the Federal District Chamber. Each edition also presents the latest election polls and exclusive reports that help readers understand the stages of the campaign.

How the weekly delivery works

The content is sent by email every Tuesday, allowing subscribers to receive a regularly updated overview before the elections. The free delivery requires only registration on G1’s website, which can be done upon entry or by creating a Globo account.

Who produces the newsletter

Journalists from the G1 team organize the news, selecting the most important facts from the electoral contests. The goal is to provide readers with concise yet comprehensive material so they are well-informed when they go to the polls.

Benefits of subscribing

By registering, users gain access to a summary that includes candidates, proposals, and poll data, all in a single email. The service is free and can be shared so more people receive the same information.

How to secure your subscription

To receive the newsletter, simply visit G1’s website, choose the subscription option, and confirm the creation or login to your Globo account. After that, the bulletin automatically arrives in your inbox every Tuesday until the second round, scheduled for October 25.

With information from G1.
